cohort: The study participants consisted of patients diagnosed with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) and a control group.
finding: The Nrf2-Keap1 pathway was found to be disrupted and the oxidant/antioxidant balance impaired in PAS patients, with Nrf2 and Keap1 levels potentially useful for determining the degree of placental invasion.
cross-section timing: At the time of Placenta Accreta Spectrum diagnosis/presence
